{{Quote|So today we have a revitalized mining industry, thriving trade, slow but continued immigration, and a growing tourism business. Including Skifter Station and lots of other gambling emporiums groundside.|Voort saBinring describing Kuratooine|<ref name="XWMK" />}}
'''Kuratooine''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. Though it was home to several [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] bases and a Galactic Alliance embassy, it was not officially part of the Alliance and continued to maintain its own system of laws and its own [[Kuratooine government|government]]. Its capital was [[Kura City]]. [[Turman Durra]] and [[Myri Antilles]] traveled to the city, disguised as honeymooners, as the other members of Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]] in different disguises traveled in pairs or threes, in order to set up their new temporary [[Wraith Headquarters (Kuratooine)|headquarters]] for their operation against Galactic Alliance Army [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]].<ref name="XWMK" />
